title: Thai Fig and Sweet Italian Bread Dessert
description: A unique Thai-inspired dessert featuring sweet Italian bread, rich figs, and a crispy bake.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat coconut milk for best results

instructions: 2. Slice the Italian bread into 1-inch thick slices.
3. In a small bowl, mix together honey, coconut milk, salt, and vanilla extract (if using).
4. Brush the mixture onto each bread slice.
5. Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Drizzle melted butter over the bread slices.
7. Sprinkle baking powder evenly over the bread slices.
8. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
9. While the bread is baking, toss the chopped figs with a pinch of salt.
10. Once the bread is ready, let it cool for a few minutes.
11. Top each bread slice with a spoonful of figs and serve warm.
